title: Accept a prepass-only first attempt as the prior record for round two
body:
Outcome: a second D10 attempt can use --prior-record when the first attempt stopped at a BLOCKING prepass (record with zero judges); today src/flow/prior.ts:107 refuses with 'requires the same panel roles as the prior review' (exit 64), so the krn-lead step 'the second also uses --prior-record' cannot be followed and round two silently becomes a fresh round one. Observer red at base.
Evidence: PR #167 attempt 1 record .krn/runs/review-series/1052561ec2b44e4e4903cb5b49a2b0481e70b6d02a6d870c4f897c8aad6ffdef/records/1.json (judges 0, prepass 1 BLOCKING); the --prior-record call on head b27a36b exited 64 without reserving.
Lead trap: krn-lead runs attempt 2 without --prior-record after a prepass-only FAIL until this ships.
